summary.en: The halftone sound: a D minor print-shop bed over a 3-3-2 press ostinato, a stamp per word, a thud as the anchor lands and strikes, silence before the pull-back.
summary.zh: halftone 的声音：D 小调印刷车间音乐床，底下是 3-3-2 节奏的印刷机，每个词一声盖章，锚点落定与击出各一声闷响，拉远前静默。

fits: Print-styled launches; anything with one recurring brand piece.

intent.en: The rhythm of a printing press sets the film in a print shop, and its silence makes the pull-back land.
intent.zh: 印刷机的节奏把片子放进印刷车间，它的静默让拉远落得住。

content.en: A film on the arc of its style; event kinds from the scenes' plans.
content.zh: 按其风格骨架编排的片子；事件种类来自各场景的 plan。

fits.zh: 印刷风格的发布片；有一个反复出现的品牌件的片子。

en: Give the push-in before the lock-up a rest section: without that silence the pull-back does not land.
zh: 落版前的推近要给一段 rest：没有这段静默，拉远落不住。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; its presets and cues are read off the template's score.mjs (card, Differs from upstream)
